name: Fish Taggers
summary:
Don’t let the name fool you — Fish Taggers isn’t about fish. It’s about fast-paced, physics-based chaos in VR. Run, jump, climb, and tag your way through wild maps using only your hands. No joysticks. No teleporting. Just raw movement and skill.

Inspired by the viral hit Gorilla Tag, Fish Taggers brings that same high-energy locomotion to a new world full of intense chases, creative maps, and a wild community. Whether you're the hunter or the hunted, every match is a workout — and a blast.
